hooks.name: command.exit
description: Thrown after the user's ran command is finished.

vars.Name: code
Doc: The exit code of what was executed.

vars.Name: cmdStr
Doc: The command or code that was executed.

hooks.name: command.not-executable
description: Thrown when the user attempts to run a file that is not executable
(like a text file, or a binary without +x permission).

hooks.name: command.not-found
description: Thrown if the command attempted to execute was not found.
This can be used to customize the text printed when a command is not found.
example: print(string.format('The command "%s" was not found.', cmd))

hooks.name: command.preexec
description: Thrown right before a command is executed.

vars.Name: input
Doc: The raw string the user typed, before alias expansion and argument substitution.

vars.Name: cmdStr
Doc: The command that will be directly executed by the current runner.
